high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "entertainmenttonight." The post features two individuals, Kendall Jenner and Bad Bunny, who appear to be exes. The text overlay on the image reads: "Kendall and Bad Bunny are totally back together." A SOURCE TELLS ET The post includes a statement from Entertainment Tonight (ET) indicating that there has been a reconciliation between Kendall Jenner and Bad Bunny.
